The '''Galactic Travel Commission''' was an authority responsible for galaxy-wide travel. The commission received a share of every ticket bought by travelers on official passenger transports.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] the players can buy flights to other cities and planets at [[shuttleport]]s and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. When a ticket is bought, a system message notifies the player that the payment has been made to the Galactic Travel Commission.
